final: WITH side_counts AS (SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault GROUP BY o.dealedge), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM side_counts), step3 AS (SELECT s.record_count, s.record_count - a.avg_count AS difference FROM side_counts AS s CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS a WHERE s.record_count > a.avg_count) SELECT SUM(record_count), AVG(difference) FROM step3
